title: Campus Bicycle Disappearance at Riverdale University
description: A high-end road bicycle disappeared from university grounds between 16:00 and 19:30 on Wednesday.

clues.title: Owner Initial Report
clues.content: Student Sarah Chen reported locking her red Trek Domane bicycle at the Science Quad bike rack at 16:15 using a steel U-lock.

clues.title: Campus Patrol Observation
clues.content: Campus safety officer observed a red bicycle secured at the Science Quad bike rack during scheduled patrol at 17:00.

clues.title: Groundskeeper Statement (Contradiction)
clues.content: Campus maintenance groundskeeper swept the Science Quad plaza at 16:50 and insists the bike rack was completely vacant with zero bicycles present.

clues.title: Cafeteria Notice (Irrelevant)
clues.content: University dining services posted that the student union cafeteria served roasted vegetable lasagna between 12:00 and 14:00.

clues.title: Pathway CCTV Footage
clues.content: Pathway security camera #6 captures an unidentified individual riding a red road bike toward North Perimeter Gate at 17:45.

clues.title: Owner Correction Statement
clues.content: Sarah Chen called dispatch to correct her initial statement: after checking her calendar, she realized she parked the bike at the Library Annex rack at 16:15, not at the Science Quad.

clues.title: Library Annex Desk Attendant
clues.content: Library student worker recalls seeing a red road bicycle locked outside the Library Annex glass entrance at 17:10.

clues.title: Physical Lock Evidence
clues.content: Campus safety officer recovered severed remnants of a heavy-duty steel U-lock in a bushes trash bin adjacent to the Library Annex.

clues.title: Duplicate Library Attendant Record
clues.content: Library student worker recalls seeing a red road bicycle locked outside the Library Annex glass entrance at 17:10.

clues.title: North Gate Turnstile Telemetry
clues.content: North perimeter gate vehicle barrier recorded an unscheduled override passage at 17:48 with no card badge scan registered.
